name: description-list
summary: One thing's details as pairs of a term and its value, such as a recipe's prep time and servings.

properties.name: stackBelow
properties.description: Below this width of the list itself (sm 448, md 512 points) each term sits above its details; above it the terms form a column beside them.

slots.name: items
slots.description: The pairs, in order: a term and its details, which are words or a view.

states.name: rest
states.description: Terms muted, details in the foreground, a line between pairs.

accessibility.name: Each pair is heard as its term, then its details.
accessibility.apple: A pair whose details are words is one element, "Prep time, 20 minutes"; one whose details are a view keeps its parts.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.List of ControlType.ListItem, each named by its term and details.

cases.person: Prep time over 20 minutes, a line, then Serves over 6, on a phone.

deviations: items is a property of { term, details } on web.
items are OuroDescriptionItem values: a term and details as a string or a view. At the accessibility text sizes it always stacks.
